verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator is a mobile MFA, passwordless sign-in and credential app. User-configurable autonomous background automations fall outside what this kind of product would offer. Built-in behaviors such as automatic cloud backup and hourly location checks are fixed security features, not automations the user sets up, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
